# GetProductReview

> Independent, hands-on product reviews by Gelei. Honest verdicts with disclosed methodology — no affiliate fluff, no sponsored coverage.

GetProductReview publishes long-form reviews of products the author has personally used. Each review covers what was tested, what worked, what didn't, who the product is for, and a clear recommendation. Methodology is disclosed on every post.

## Reviews

- [Sample Review: Notion vs Obsidian for Daily Knowledge Work](https://getproductreview.com/reviews/sample-review): A six-month head-to-head between two leading personal knowledge management apps, evaluating capture friction, retrieval, sync reliability, and long-term portability.

## About

- [About GetProductReview](https://getproductreview.com/about): About the site, the author, methodology, and disclosures.
